logic.entry: At a newly closed UTC 15m bar j, compute simple return close[j]/close[j-1]-1. If flat and return <= -entry_15m_drop_fraction (equality qualifies), enter long at next 15m block first one-minute open after one-minute availability buffer.
logic.rebound_exit: Store signal close[j] as recovery_reference. On later completed 15m closes, exit if close[j] >= recovery_reference (equality qualifies).
logic.time_exit: Also exit once j-entry_execution_bar_index >= max_holding_15m_bars. If both rebound and timeout conditions occur together, process one full exit. Exit executes at next block first minute open after a one-minute buffer.
logic.state: After exit, do not re-enter on the same decision bar. Retry no rejected historical fill retroactively; this is a bar-close backtest with the next-block minute-open reference. Start OOS flat.
logic.sizing: Independent $2,000 maximum-affordable unlevered spot; preserve USDT residue; no shorting, leverage, add-on, cross-asset exposure, cash yield, or pre-OOS fills.
